name: NFT Accounts
summary: Open the membership seat. Each NFT is an onchain account that can hold $ACCC.

name: Claim & harvest
summary: Claim the 1,000 $ACCC genesis grant into the NFT Account, then harvest yield on what stays.

name: Collection
summary: Browse mints, holders, and $ACCC sitting in NFT Accounts.

name: TokenSmart desktop
summary: Open TokenSmart in a new tab. Anyone can sign in; holding ACCC NFTs or $ACCC on this wallet unlocks extra programs and rooms there.

name: Launch desk
summary: Public mint, membership NFT, and NFT Account setup — the rails ACCC used on itself.

name: Distribution studio
summary: Genesis grants and yield schedules other teams can run without a private allocation list.

name: Genesis lounge
summary: Member-only desk for holders who still keep original genesis $ACCC in the NFT Account.

name: Liquidity rails
summary: Listing and buyback plumbing funded by tool revenue. Reserved for accounts that kept principal.

name: Factory license
summary: The same stack ACCC ships with, sold as software so independent teams do not need a cabal.
